identity.assignment_crosswalk: README GIS crosswalk row 199; assignment_queue item 172 gives initial TEL/FID 199; live Purdue BuildingShapes response returns matching code/name/address; independent OSM way 159752232 is named Telecommunications Building (TEL), addr:housenumber=191.

source_resolution.resolution: Use the Purdue GIS FID 199 ring vertices. The GIS Shape__Area attribute materially conflicts with ring and independent OSM area; it is not used to rescale the outline.

geometry.footprint_source: Purdue GIS FID 199 single closed ring; converted to repository campus coordinates with X=(lon+86.9137)*111412.84*cos(40.4274), Y=(lat-40.4274)*111040.0.
geometry.height_method: Median class-1 surface elevation minus median class-2 ground in exterior buffer; 3m erosion applied in feetUS in EPSG:2968. Nearest-rank quantiles.
geometry.height_uncertainty: Roof height is an estimate from unclassified surface points; no class-6 building returns in tile. Interior central statistic can include remaining vegetation or non-roof returns; compare spread and orthophoto. GIS reports four levels but its Extrution/R fields have undocumented units.
geometry.roof: Broad flat roof supported by 2018 Indiana orthophoto. Four low-proxy equipment units are placed from the visible roof cluster; their sizes/heights are schematic and not measured.

facade.material: unverified; neutral gray massing material used, no unsupported material is claimed.
facade.windows: unverified; not modeled in this first evidence-limited pass.

main_entrance.modeled: single simple entrance opening proxy on closest Purdue GIS wall; width and height are schematic.

sources.measurement_method: Official feature response; source ring transformed to project local campus approximation.
sources.uncertainty: Official campus GIS map polygon; not structural survey. Shape__Area/Length attributes conflict with polygon-ring geometry.

sources.measurement_method: Independent identity/footprint cross-check; named way, house number 191 and entrance=main node.
sources.uncertainty: Crowd-sourced; no measured facade/material/height; entrance point is 1.33m outside official ring and was projected to nearest GIS boundary segment.

sources.measurement_method: Shapely polygon area, perimeter, centroid offset and boundary Hausdorff in meters.
sources.uncertainty: Comparison depends on stated local geographic approximation.

sources.measurement_method: Institutional building identity, address and reported area.
